card.text: The first planet seen crossing its star: a hot giant 1.36 Jupiter radii wide on a 3.5-day orbit.

sources.label: Charbonneau et al. 2000
sources.quote: We detect two separate transit events

introduction.text: HD 209458 b was the first planet seen crossing its star. It is a gas giant 1.36 times as wide as Jupiter, shown as a sphere glowing at its measured dayside heat.

sources.label: Charbonneau et al. 2000
sources.quote: We detect two separate transit events

thermal.title: Dayside heat
thermal.summary: The colour of a black body at the 1,499 K day side measured in eclipse.

temperature.title: Spitzer heat map
temperature.summary: Heat at 4.5 µm from the paper's phase-curve fit. It varies only with longitude: the data hold no north-south detail.
